sections.label: Summary
sections.text: Checkout returned 5xx for 25 minutes after the payments rollout; rolled back.

sections.label: Signals / Symptoms
sections.text: The checkout dashboard showed the error rate climbing from the usual background to several percent within minutes of the deploy window, with latency rising in step. The checkout dashboard showed the error rate climbing from the usual background to several percent within minutes of the deploy window, with latency rising in step. Envoy reported upstream_reset_before_response_started on the payments cluster and the checkout pods logged ECONNRESET from the payments client; HikariCP warned that a connection was not available after 30000ms.

sections.label: Root cause
sections.text: Payments rev7 shipped a client with a one-second pool acquire timeout.

sections.label: Resolution
sections.text: Rolled payments back to rev6; the leaked key [redacted] was rotated.
